purpose: Task latency relative to Auto for revised presentation; does not replace frozen benchmark values

selection.intersection_key: case_id within the fixed full70 repetition

formulas.relative_percent: 100 * mode_statistic / Auto_statistic on the same common subset
formulas.paired_task_distribution: p50/p95 of 100*(mode_duration_ms/Auto_duration_ms -1), matched by case_id; distinct from ratios of cohort quantiles

crosscheck_against_frozen_unmatched_cli_: PASS for n, p50 and p95 in all three modes

main_slide_recommendation.display_label: Median task duration on 65 identical normally completed runs; relative to Auto
main_slide_recommendation.avoid_three_arm_primary: The n=24 intersection is selected by Secure headless errors and excludes most tasks

limitations: This is a post-hoc descriptive matched-completion subset, not a new model experiment.
Normally completed includes functional task failures, not only legitimate successful tasks.
Changed action trajectories and outcome-dependent completion selection prevent interpreting this as pure added protection overhead.
Auto/Dos all-case common subset is n=65; legitimate/ordinary common subset is n=36 and is separately labelled.
Secure has45 errors and1 timeout in full70; common three-arm n=24 is strongly selected and must not be advertised as a general speedup.
Auto has2 timeouts and Dos has4. Error/timeout results remain in benchmark diagnostics and ASR/utility, outside these completed-run latency subsets.
No model calls, changes to original fixtures, or edits to frozen ledger/scorer were performed.
